lines.text: Walk by tapping the ground or using the pad.
Wait advances one strategic turn when you are ready.
Tap nearby people or hazards to Observe, then choose an action.
Open Inventory (I) to use, equip or drop carried items.
World Map (M) is read-only strategic geography.
Talk to workers after Inspecting the rockfall for quest help.
Reaching 10 VP triggers the Historic transition automatically.
